featured_reviews.name: abhi santos
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you truly want your wedding day to be smooth and perfect, I strongly advise you to think twice before trusting Gautam Wedding Events.
My experience with them was extremely disappointing and caused unnecessary stress on one of the most important days of my life.

I had booked 50 “Pheta” pieces at ₹100 each for a 12 PM delivery, and this booking was done one month in advance. I even paid 50% advance to confirm the order.

But on the day of my wedding:
•	They completely forgot they had to come to my place.
•	Only after I reminded them did they say the exact Pheta I booked was not available.
•	They kept promising they would arrange the same colour, but from 10 AM to 1:30 PM, while my function had already started, they still failed to provide anything.

From my experience, it became very clear that:
•	They do not own their items — they borrow from others and pass it to customers.
•	They were highly unprofessional in handling something so important.
•	The people coordinating with us were immature and lacked basic manners or civic sense.

Because of their mismanagement and false assurances, my father was deeply hurt, as his only wish was that all the Baraatis wear Pheta — something we had booked well in advance.

Instead of fixing the issue, their only solution was “Take your advance back”, as if we could magically arrange 50 Phetas at the last moment.

I am writing this review so others do not go through the same embarrassment and stress.
Sometimes paying ₹100 extra to a reliable vendor is far better than risking your special day with careless and unprofessional service providers.

This was my genuine experience, and I hope it helps someone else make a better decision.

The launch highlights ongoing efforts to strengthen domestic capabilities and support long-term growth within the aviation industry.

The event highlighted ongoing efforts to build partnerships across different sectors.

The venue was thoughtfully adapted to reflect the publication’s legacy, with elements highlighting its long-standing association with global entertainment.

The event also marked the unveiling of the first Indian edition cover, featuring Akshay Kumar, Ajay Devgn, Salman Khan, and Aamir Khan.

The launch represents the beginning of Variety’s presence in India and its engagement with the country’s film and media landscape.

featured_reviews.review_text:
*Extremely disappointing experience with Vows Vachan – poor management & execution*

We recently hired Vows Vachan for our wedding, and unfortunately, their services were a complete letdown. While we expected a well-organized and seamless experience, what we got was chaos, mismanagement, and a complete lack of professionalism.

The negatives:
- Lack of execution & coordination: From the very beginning, there was no structured planning, leading to confusion at every stage. My sister and I barely got to participate in the wedding, as we were constantly solving problems, managing tasks, and searching for team members who were missing when needed.
- Unreliable team support: During both pujas, not a single team member was available, forcing us to handle everything on our own.
- Guest dissatisfaction: Many of our guests approached us, frustrated with the disorganization and lack of assistance, questioning why we had hired a team that seemed completely unhelpful.
- Disastrous departures: There was no structure in place for guest departures, and the team failed to manage hotel staff, leading to unnecessary confusion and frustration.
- False claims of experience: Despite assurances that they had extensive experience working in Goa, it was clear that this was not the case. The team failed to coordinate with local vendors and mismanaged transport services, making things even more inconvenient.
- Poor vendor management: The options provided for arrangements were subpar, rushed, and lacked any real thought or practicality. Even for the musical pheras, where we had already selected a vendor, the team failed to ensure smooth execution.
- Mediocre décor, not as per expectations: The décor was not what we had asked for—the proportions were wrong, and the excessive use of artificial flowers was disappointing.

Final verdict:
Working with Vows Vachan was a frustrating and stressful experience, and we do not recommend their services to anyone. Instead of handling logistics and ensuring a smooth wedding, they added to our stress and failed at every level of execution. This feedback is being shared with all heads of Vows Vachan, as this was not just a failure of one team but a complete breakdown in management. If you are considering them for your wedding, think twice before making the same mistake we did.
